summary: Evidence-backed acceptance plan for warehouse order allocation covering atomic reservation, priority processing, idempotent order IDs, and immutable handling of invalid orders.

requirements.description: All lines in an order must be reserved atomically. Repeated SKUs across lines are summed prior to stock evaluation; if any SKU has insufficient stock, none are allocated.

sources.quote: Reserve all lines of an order together or reserve nothing; repeated SKU lines must be added together before checking stock.

acceptance.given: Current warehouse stock and an order containing multiple line items, including potential duplicate SKUs
acceptance.when: The order reservation is evaluated against stock
acceptance.then: Either all required quantities are deducted together if stock is sufficient, or stock remains untouched and insufficient_stock is returned

requirements.description: Expedited orders take precedence over normal orders regardless of arrival order, while orders within the same priority level preserve their relative input sequence.

sources.quote: Expedited orders get stock before normal orders; preserve arrival order within each priority.

acceptance.given: A list of orders with mixed expedited and normal priorities
acceptance.then: All valid expedited orders are fulfilled in arrival order first, followed by valid normal orders in arrival order

requirements.description: Each order ID is processed once based on its first occurrence; any subsequent orders sharing the same ID are completely ignored.

sources.quote: An order ID is idempotent: process only its first occurrence and ignore later duplicates.

acceptance.given: An order sequence containing duplicate order IDs
acceptance.when: Orders are ingested and evaluated for fulfillment
acceptance.then: The first occurrence claims the ID and only that occurrence is evaluated or rejected, while later occurrences are ignored entirely

requirements.description: Orders with invalid lines or invalid metadata are rejected without modifying stock, and caller input objects remain unmutated.

sources.quote: Invalid order lines must be rejected without changing stock, and callers must retain their original input objects.

acceptance.given: Input stock and orders containing invalid lines, malformed structures, or unfulfillable quantities
acceptance.then: Failure reasons are recorded, stock is unchanged, and all input objects and arrays remain strictly unmutated

assumptions: Stock is represented as a plain object mapping nonempty string SKU keys to nonnegative safe-integer stock counts.
Order priorities are strictly 'expedited' or 'normal'; other priority values result in invalid_order rejections.
Orders with missing or invalid IDs are rejected with id: null and reason: 'invalid_order'.
Repeated line items for the same SKU within an order that overflow safe integers fail with reason: 'invalid_lines'.
